overall_notes: The paper focuses on improving RAG systems through multi-agent document filtering. It evaluates NLG outputs (question answering and long-form generation) using automatic metrics. The key insight for Q3 is that Agent-2 (Judge) uses an LLM (Mistral-7B) to evaluate document relevance after retrieval but before final generation, which qualifies as LLM-as-judge evaluation of intermediate outputs.
